visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows only on hover. Default is flat with 1px border.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-md (max 6px) to maintain a highly structured, strict Swiss look.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only on the sticky nav and AI chat widget: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section for the 'elite' tactile feel.

grids_and_layouts.marketing: Asymmetrical Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) with wide gaps (gap-12) and massive padding (p-16 to p-32).
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid with strict column alignment (gap-4). Use border-collapse patterns for tables.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and sharp border darkening.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-opacity) duration 300ms ease-out.
motion.animations: Framer Motion for page entrances. Smooth stagger children for the calendar grid.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Use dark text (#0A0A0A) on light backgrounds.
accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all Framer Motion and CSS animations.

images.description: Spacious and stylish hair salon interior

3d_libraries.recommendation: Framer Motion 3D for simple, performant card transitions on pricing. Avoid heavy 3D canvas libraries to keep the SaaS booking engine blisteringly fast and professional.

calendar.rules: Must support drag-and-drop, color-coded appointments, and multi-view. Use CSS Grid for the layout. No full-calendar library overhead if possible, use standard date-fns math + framer-motion.
calendar.ui: Flat, 1px border, high-contrast text. Current day highlighted with a Vermillion dot or border.

ai_receptionist_widget.rules: Floating glassmorphic chat interface. Fixed at bottom right. Smooth slide-up animation.

general.shadcn: Use heavily customized Shadcn components for complex logic (Select, DatePicker, Dialog). Strip rounded borders to match the sharp Swiss design.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter for headings.
Create a strict, high-contrast interface. No soft SaaS blues.
Use Manrope for all UI text, JetBrains Mono for times/metrics.
Use 1px borders extensively instead of card shadows.
Padding should be generous on marketing (py-24) and dense on dashboards (p-4).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Use named exports for components, default exports for pages.
DO NOT apply transition: all universally.
DO NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; strictly use lucide-react.
